question: Does moving the stop to breakeven after TP1 help on this ladder?
method: bars re-walked in full under each rule on identical entries (MFE cannot answer this — it is the peak under the original stop), paired comparison
verdict: Keep it: +0.0102R per trade, t=2.20, positive on 8 of 10 instruments. Marginal, not overwhelming.
note: A sibling project measured this rule as harmful (cost 556R). It does not transfer: this ladder places TP1 at 1.2R, above the stop, so reaching it banks 0.4R before the stop moves. A ladder with TP1 inside the stop gives up upside without securing enough.
